gen-unbounded-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono lays its tall, uniform letters out like nails on a ruler, gliding under the eye without any thick-and-thin to snag it. Unbounded gives it a wide, friendly head.
gen-unbounded-gf-geist-mono: Unbounded spreads out wide and friendly with a welcoming c. Geist Mono, a monospace with high-rising lowercase and big gaps between letters, gives that a structured, code-style counterweight.
gen-unbounded-gf-major-mono-display: Unbounded spreads its wide, friendly lettering across the top, low in contrast and easygoing. Major Mono Display, a monospace, draws every letter in one tube-like line like neon glass, with sweeping open curves.
gen-unbounded-gf-martian-mono: Martian Mono sets loose, far-apart code-style letters with generous openings in every curve, one marker line tracing each. Unbounded's oversized, spreading lowercase above it makes the page feel friendly and technical at once.
gen-unbounded-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono reads bold and fixed-width, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Over a longer stretch it keeps a steady, precise tick, every diagonal as thick as the uprights, while Unbounded stays wide and friendly overhead.
gen-unbounded-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono reads loose and magnified, with rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord and bowls left open on one side. Unbounded does the friendly, spread-out announcing, while Victor Mono keeps the structured, precise detail underneath.
gen-unbounded-newsreader: Friendly and contemporary, Unbounded sprawls wide with oversized lowercase. Newsreader, a serif with lower, restrained stroke contrast and open jaws on its curves, tightens that up into something authoritative and refined.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee reads approachable, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem and its strokes thick like neon glass tubing. Vast Shadow grabs attention with vintage flair; the sans simply carries the words.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-aldrich: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width, with a tall mean line and plenty of space around each letter. Aldrich, a plain sans, answers with its tall x-height and cupped round letters.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads clean and professional, with wide open c terminals and a tall body carrying short stems above and below. Vast Shadow sits beside it with vintage, eye-catching swagger, thin-free and swell-free.
